name: TRACE
description: TRACE is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate continual learning in aligned large language models. It consists of 8 distinct datasets covering challenging tasks such as domain-specific tasks, multilingual capabilities, code generation, and mathematical reasoning, standardized into a unified format for automatic evaluation.
reputation: A specialized continual-learning benchmark that has been cited in research on aligned LLM adaptation, but it is not yet a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Highlights challenges in continual learning for aligned LLMs, showing significant declines in performance after training; introduces Reasoning-augmented Continual Learning (RCL) to mitigate forgetting.
